expectations.text: tfctl was called with the invalid run ID run-NONEXISTENT12345
The output clearly communicates that the run was not found or an error occurred
The error message includes the specific run ID 'run-NONEXISTENT12345'
expectations.evidence: Run ID appears in both header line and tfctl invocation line of response

expectations.text: The response stops at the first failed API call — no follow-up calls to /task-stages or /policy-evaluations are attempted with this invalid ID
expectations.evidence: commands.log only contains a single /runs/run-NONEXISTENT12345 API call (EXIT: 2)

expectations.text: No fabricated policy evaluations, policy-sets, or outcomes are shown in the response
expectations.evidence: Response contains no policy tables — only error explanation and recovery suggestions

expectations.text: The response surfaces the actual error wording from tfctl/stderr (e.g. 'Resource not found', 'unauthorized') rather than a generic 'an error occurred' message
expectations.evidence: Response includes verbatim tfctl error: 'Resource not found or you are unauthorized to this action. Check your account permissions.'

expectations.text: The response offers at least one concrete recovery suggestion (verify the run ID, check active profile, or run tfctl profile display) rather than just reporting failure
expectations.evidence: Response suggests: 'Verify the run ID, then check the active profile with tfctl auth info (or re-initialise with tfctl profile init) and retry.'
